purpose: Regression scenarios for evidence-first product design, blocking Visual Design Authority, implementation-first runtime visual proof, progressive context routing, provider-neutral Design Action Fabric execution, safe design-provider mutation and recovery, Figma design/code/library/motion/assets/Code Connect workflows, evidence-first design-system reuse, resumable design-session state, live URL reconstruction, cross-tool design-system synchronization, component labs, reference research, fidelity, and graceful degradation. It also pressures qualitative visual calibration and bounded product-pattern retrieval so design intelligence stays coherent without turning into a universal style score or a giant always-loaded catalog. It also pressures materialized visual-shotgun exploration, first-viewport craft, image-first art direction only where appropriate, iterative designer critique, optical typography, state completeness, and advisory—not authoritative—UI slop scanning.
